name: Quail Eggs
siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as they're naturally FODMAP-free and easy to digest. No fermentation concerns.
preparationTips: Crack carefully due to small size - use a serrated knife or special quail egg scissors
Boil for 2-3 minutes for hard-boiled eggs due to their small size
Store in refrigerator and use within 3-4 weeks of purchase
Perfect for appetizers, salads, or as protein garnish
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin B12 and selenium
Good source of choline for brain health
